name: organicmaps
description: 🍃 Organic Maps is a free Android & iOS offline maps app for more than 12M travelers, tourists, hikers, and cyclists. It uses crowd-sourced OpenStreetMap data and is developed with love by the community. No ads, no tracking, no data collection, no crapware. Please donate to support the development!

latest_release.name: 2026.11.11-39-android
latest_release.body:
• 3D terrain and ocean depths, contour lines in meters/feet, elevation at any map point
• OSM data as of November 10
• Import and display KML/KMZ/GeoJSON areas
• Public transport route details
• Redesigned speed display
• Track recording widget
• GPS elevation above mean sea level
• Track direction arrows and highlighting
• Separate driving, cycling, and walking options
• Reverse routes with stops
• Fixed recording controls, arrival times, and Android Auto crashes
…more at omaps.org/news
See [a detailed announce](https://organicmaps.app/news/) on our website when app updates are published in all stores.
You can get automatic app updates from GitHub [using Obtainium](https://github.com/organicmaps/organicmaps/wiki/Installing-Organic-Maps-from-GitHub-using-Obtainium).
